rejected.reason: Continents and geographic regions are not countries; coarsening crosses into a distinct category.

rejected.candidate: Supranational union (e.g., European Union, United Nations)
rejected.reason: Supranational bodies and alliances belong to an Organization or Geopolitical Bloc category, not Country.

rejected.candidate: Short-form vs. long-form or translation (e.g., Russian Federation -> Russia, США -> USA)
rejected.reason: Spelling variants, translations, abbreviations, and official renames are lexical aliases for the same referent at the same granularity, not ladder rungs.

ladder.notes: All supplied examples are discrete sovereign nations (with multilingual aliases and abbreviations). There are no multi-tiered country structures (such as constituent countries or overseas territories) present in the evidence to warrant a coarsening rung within the category.
